name: @playarr-tv/admin
description: Playarr Server's own admin web UI: Vite + React + TypeScript. Source-instance registration and user management -- the operator-facing control plane for the Playarr Server itself, co-hosted by playarr-bin at its own origin. Distinct from Playarr Web (clients/tv-web/web), which is the consumer streaming client that connects to Playarr Server.
